title: Cyclic Nucleotide Second Messengers: cAMP, cGMP and Their Effectors
method: Unicode lexical count of actual saved draft p.teaching-prose text with entities decoded, excluding all supplementary materials; final candidate changes only robots metadata. Article count includes headings, tables, captions, visible SVG labels, practice and references but excludes SVG title/desc and buttons.

comparator.comparison: No published 4.A chapter at baseline. Inspected published 3.C.14 actual reader and initial teaching prose plus its QA; comparable narrative scale, with topic-specific mechanism and quantitative derivations.

scientific_checks: Mapped to official merged CSIR-DBT Unit 4.A printed p.5, separate CSIR Unit 4.B p.3 and archived MP SET 2024 Unit 4.B p.3; screenshot checks performed. Academy uses revised lettering.

Reviewed cyclase phosphate fate, Gs/Gi isoform specificity, soluble AC, R2C2 regulation, CRE/CREB/CBP, EPAC/Rap, receptor vs soluble GC, NO heme recognition, PKG ATP donor, direct CNG gating, rod sign, PDE2/PDE3 cross-talk, source/sink kinetics, saturation, binding vs activation, phosphorylation steady state, local pools, FRET and rescue controls.
Landmark source records and relevant textbook sections/abstracts checked, with historical evidence distinguished from hypothetical datasets.
Separate review improved structural diagrams, PDE inhibition symbolism, graph scaling, citation labels and ambiguous cyclase terminology.

academic_self_review.method: Separate internal author review, not external peer review. Scope: all explicit roadmap responsibilities with boundaries. Accuracy: verified mechanisms and qualified simplifications; deduction for source-access limits. Depth: progressive teaching and causal explanation in 144 distinct paragraphs. Evidence/quantitative: 31 recalculations and model assumptions; some experiments described conceptually rather than full historical datasets. Practice: 52 explained items, balanced key; not externally examiner-validated. Technical: static checks passed, but no rendered mobile or accessibility audit.

limitations: No external peer review or examiner validation; scientific source checks used available records, abstracts and accessible text rather than all full papers and editions.
